name: Trincomalee Town and Fort Frederick
tagline: The old town on the headland, under the fort and the temple
description: The town itself on the promontory, with Fort Frederick's walls enclosing Swami Rock and the Koneswaram temple above the sea. Below it are the market, the banks, the bus stand and the ordinary business of a Tamil and Muslim provincial town.
bestFor: Anyone who needs banks, the market and buses, with the temple a short walk
pros: Koneswaram temple and the fort on the headland
The lowest costs in the area
cons: Congested and hot with little shade

name: Uppuveli
tagline: The nearest beach, six kilometres north
description: The first beach strip north of the town, with a run of guesthouses and small hotels behind a stretch of sand, a handful of restaurants and enough infrastructure to be comfortable without being developed. It is the practical base for most visitors to Trincomalee.
bestFor: Most stays, for the balance of beach, services and proximity to town
pros: Sandy beach with swimmable water in season
Ten to fifteen minutes into town
cons: Largely closes during the northeast monsoon

name: Nilaveli
tagline: The long white beach further north, and the boats to Pigeon Island
description: The wide sand beach about twelve kilometres north, quieter and more spread out than Uppuveli, with the boats to Pigeon Island national park leaving from the shore. The reef there holds blacktip reef sharks and good coral, and the beach itself is largely empty.
bestFor: Stays that want the widest beach and the reef trips
pros: A long, wide and largely empty white beach
Boats to Pigeon Island and its reef from the shore
cons: Twenty to twenty-five minutes into town
Very limited services and no real shops
Shuts down almost entirely out of season

name: Inner Harbour and China Bay
tagline: Around the deep-water anchorage, naval and quiet
description: The southern side of the harbour, one of the largest natural deep-water anchorages in the world and long a naval station, with the airport at China Bay and a scatter of residential settlement. It is quiet, functional and has the harbour views without the beach.
bestFor: Practical stays near the airport with harbour views rather than a beach
pros: Views over one of the world's great natural harbours
cons: Naval restrictions on parts of the shore

name: Kanniya and the Inland Villages
tagline: The hot wells and the dry-zone country west of town
description: The area inland around the Kanniya hot wells, seven natural springs enclosed in a temple compound, with dry-zone scrub, ancient irrigation tanks and Tamil farming villages. It is rural, quiet and entirely away from the coastal economy, ten minutes from town.
bestFor: Stays that want dry-zone countryside and village life over a beach
pros: The Kanniya hot wells and the irrigation tanks
Genuine village life at the lowest cost
cons: No beach and a ride to everything
Very hot in the dry season
